settings.title: Seasonal compositions, considered.
settings.intro: An entrance is part of the home’s larger story. We bring together color, proportion, and placement to create a seasonal display that feels at ease in its setting.
settings.subheading: A thoughtful welcome, from the threshold.
settings.body_one: A broad stair can hold a generous arrangement; a narrow stoop calls for a lighter touch. At a storefront, the display should welcome visitors while keeping the entrance clear. Every setting asks for its own balance.
settings.body_two: Start with the scale of your space, then settle on a color story. In your brief, share architectural details, a requested event date, or anything you would like us to keep in mind. Individual pumpkins and gourds may vary with the harvest.
